tip.packageType: Choose the box type that fits your product. Not sure? Pick 'Recommend for me' and our experts will suggest one.
tip.boxStructure: How the box opens and is shaped — tuck top, handle, sleeve and more.
tip.quantity: Your estimated order quantity. Higher quantities lower the unit price.
tip.innerSize: The inner dimensions that hold your product (W × D × H, in mm).
tip.material: The paper stock for your box — coated, kraft and more.
tip.printing: The color printing method. CMYK is full color; spot colors match exact brand colors.
tip.finishing: Surface finishing options — coating, foil, embossing and more.
tip.designLink: Paste a link to share your design files (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.).

field.messagePh: Tell us any specific requirements, structure, references…
field.requirements: Tell us about your product and packaging needs
field.requirementsPh:
Example:
- Product: wine bottle (8cm diameter, 30cm tall)
- Purpose: gift box for wine
- Design: black background with red accents / glossy, premium stock (photo attached)
- Target date: some time in August
- Budget: under 5,000,000 KRW
field.materialIntro: If you have a specialty stock or a particular paper in mind, type it in.|Include the basis weight (gsm) if you have one.
field.materialCustomPh: Tell us the material you'd like.
field.materialEtcPh: Describe or type the material you'd like.
field.materialNeedsPackage: Please choose a package type first.
field.accessoryQ: Do you need an inner pad or other accessories to hold the product in place?
field.accessoryPh: e.g. paper dividers, inner tray, cushioning
field.printColorsTip: The right number of colours can change with the design. If you're unsure, pick ‘Other’ and describe what you want.
field.printColorsPh: Tell us the printing you'd like.
field.printSpotNote: ※ Spot colour is required when the background is printed in full colour.
field.printSpotTip: Spot colour uses pre-mixed ink to reproduce a colour exactly — used for shades standard printing can't hit, or when a brand colour must stay consistent. Pantone printing may add cost.
field.finishNote: Coating is required when the background is printed in full colour.
field.finishTip: Finishing adds durability and polish through extra processing — it lifts the perceived quality and strengthens the brand image.
field.sizeTip:
Length (L): left-to-right width when viewed from the front
Width (W): front-to-back depth when viewed from the front
Height (H): distance from the bottom to the top of the box

※ If the size isn't decided: send us the product and we'll propose a fitting size.
field.privacyTitle: Collection and Use of Personal Information
field.privacyBody: IRUM D&P collects and uses personal information from companies and individuals seeking consultation, as follows.|Purpose: pre-production consultation, sending quotes and running production|Items collected: name, company, phone, email, city/country|Retention: the information is destroyed without exception once the purpose is met.|If you do not agree, we cannot provide consultation or a quote.
field.promoBody: Do you agree to us featuring the finished work on our website, portfolio and social media?
field.priorityDesc: We will shape the quote around your priority.
field.budgetTip: Sharing a budget helps us review your request accurately.
field.leadTimeTip:
Average production time (business days, after the design is approved)
Paper boxes: about 14 days
Corrugated boxes and poly: about 20 days
Rigid boxes and shopping bags: about 30 days
field.quantityTip:
Minimum order varies by package type and size.
Boxes: 1,000–2,000 pcs
Shopping bags: 1,000–20,000 pcs
Poly: 10,000–20,000 pcs

※ Unit price usually drops as quantity rises.
field.designNeededTip: Design fees may apply separately depending on the scope and complexity of the work.
field.extraRequestDesc: Add anything useful beyond what you have entered.|(e.g. purpose, preferred mood, brands you like)|The more detail, the more accurate the quote.
